patches.summary: Hand-built local SQLite and ISO-BMFF source adapter for Apple Voice Memos, including freshness-aware daemon and hidden-app synchronization.
patches.reason: Voice Memos exposes no documented HTTP API, and Printing Press generation does not model local macOS SQLite and media stores.
patches.validated_outcome: Race tests, go vet, govulncheck, GoReleaser snapshot packaging, synthetic fixtures, and live read-only macOS dogfood passed.
